title: ipva-bilevel: code and data for 'Strong convergence of an inertial proximal gradient method for convex bilevel optimization with nonsmooth objectives'
description: Code and stored results that reproduce the numerical experiments of the paper 'Strong convergence of an inertial proximal gradient method for convex bilevel optimization with nonsmooth objectives' by Kobkoon Janngam and Suthep Suantai. The scripts regenerate Tables 1 and 2 and Figures 1 and 2 of the paper (image inpainting) and check every number quoted in its section 4.
